title: Summit Standing and the Reinstated Term of Crestline Credits
content:
**Summit benefit term.** A credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers that is reinstated has a reinstated term built on its member-standing term. The member-standing term depends on the holder's standing in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program:

- **8 calendar months** for a Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman member, and for a Summit Gold member whose qualifying dollars this year have reached the qualifying-dollars threshold of Summit Gold in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program;
- **7 calendar months** for any other Summit Gold member, and for a Summit Silver member whose qualifying dollars this year have reached the qualifying-dollars threshold of Summit Silver in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program;
- **the instrument's reinstated validity months** for every other holder.

"Reached" means the qualifying dollars this year are at least the threshold of the member's own tier. The records that decide the term are the holder's Summit tier and qualifying dollars this year on the Summit membership, and the qualifying-dollars threshold the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets for that tier.

## Tier and qualifying dollars in combination

| Summit tier of the holder | Qualifying dollars this year have reached the tier's threshold | Member-standing term |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Chairman | yes or no | 8 months |
| Summit Diamond | yes or no | 8 months |
| Summit Platinum | yes or no | 8 months |
| Summit Gold | yes | 8 months |
| Summit Gold | no | 7 months |
| Summit Silver | yes | 7 months |
| Summit Silver | no | instrument's reinstated validity months |
| Summit Member, or a holder with no Summit membership | not applicable | instrument's reinstated validity months |

## Boundary on the threshold (hypothetical figures)

Take a Summit tier whose threshold is 5,000 qualifying dollars. A Summit Gold member with 5,000.00 qualifying dollars this year has reached it, so the term is 8 months. With 4,999.99 the threshold is not reached, so the term is 7 months. A Summit Silver member measured against the Summit Silver threshold is treated the same way: reaching it gives 7 months, and falling short of it gives the instrument's reinstated validity months. The threshold figure is an example only. The actual figure is the one the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets for the tier.
